mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 for 2 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year while the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a housing-led economic boom that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) of more than 3% year-over-year signals rising inflation expectations that will pressure the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y-o-y change > 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4% while payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing by more than 200,000 per month, it signals a tight labor market that will boost wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 200k per month
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) grows by more than 5% year-over-year while the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals a supply-side boom that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales (RSAFS) of more than 5% month-over-month signals a sudden weakening in consumer demand that will pressure S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS m-o-m change < -5% but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
